correctness.rationale: C: Exact support over diagonal and cross vertices equals max(D_A,D_B,max g_A+max h_B,max g_B+max h_A). For q/n→0 the B-diagonal max lies strictly below the p-diagonal leading scale; Taylor expanding Gaussian centering b_q−a b_p produces delta exactly with q prefactor a(4pi)^a and logarithmic exponent a. Gumbel maxima for the distinct Gaussian variables have asymptotically independent upper-tail point processes because all different standardized forms have correlation <1, with negative signed form pairs harmless. Intrinsic width uses the projected Gaussian chi-radius R independent of uniform direction; replacing R with eta_{2n-2} is o_P(1/r_n) by R concentration, and Gaussian tail bounds supply uniform integrability for the mean statement. Conditioning exponential transforms produces F_a(s)=int exp(-u-exp(-s)u^{-1/a})du and P_delta=E[F_a(sqrt2 G-delta)^2]. Independently evaluated centering r_n(b_q−a b_p) for delta=1.2 at log n 10^3, 10^4, 10^6, converging 1.226172→1.205501→1.200139. The proof is asymptotic and supplies no quantitative convergence rate.
